meaning: A clear liquid that is essential for life.
description: Water is a natural resource needed by people, animals, and plants.
english_explanation: Water is used for drinking, cooking, farming, cleaning, and many other activities.
akan_explanation: Nsuo yɛ adeɛ a ɛho hia paa ma nkwa. Nnipa, mmoa ne afifideɛ nyinaa hia nsuo na wɔatena ase.
usage_context: Daily life, farming, health, and environment

meaning: A strong feeling of care, affection, and concern.
description: Love involves caring for and showing kindness toward another person.
english_explanation: Love can be shown toward family, friends, neighbours, humanity, and God.
akan_explanation: Ɔdɔ yɛ nkateɛ a ɛma obi kyerɛ ne yɔnko anaa obi foforɔ dɔ ne ayamye.

meaning: An expression used to show appreciation or gratitude.
description: It is used when someone wants to appreciate help, kindness, or a good action.
english_explanation: Thank you is a polite expression of gratitude.
akan_explanation: Meda ase yɛ asɛm a yɛka de kyerɛ anisɔ ne ahobrɛaseɛ.
example_twi: Meda ase wɔ wo mmoa ho.

meaning: A greeting used to receive someone warmly.
description: Welcome expresses happiness and acceptance when someone arrives.
english_explanation: It is commonly used when receiving visitors or guests.
akan_explanation: Akwaaba yɛ Akanfoɔ nkyia a wɔde gye ahɔhoɔ fɛfɛɛfɛ.

meaning: A place where people learn knowledge, skills, and values.
description: A school is an educational institution where students learn under teachers.
english_explanation: Schools help students develop academically and socially.
akan_explanation: Sukuu yɛ beaeɛ a asuafoɔ kɔ sua adeɛ, nya nimdeɛ ne abrabɔ mu nteteeɛ.
example_english: Students go to school to learn.
example_twi: Asuafoɔ kɔ sukuu kɔ sua adeɛ.

meaning: A person who studies or receives education.
description: A student is someone who learns in a school or other educational institution.
english_explanation: Students acquire knowledge, skills, and understanding through study.
akan_explanation: Osuani yɛ obi a ɔkɔ sukuu sua adeɛ na ɔnya nimdeɛ.
example_english: The student is reading a book.

meaning: A person who teaches others.
description: A teacher helps learners acquire knowledge and skills.
english_explanation: Teachers guide students through lessons, explanations, and activities.
akan_explanation: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛni yɛ obi a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ asuafoɔ na ɔboa wɔn ma wɔnya nimdeɛ.

meaning: A written or printed work containing information or stories.
description: A book contains organized written information for reading and learning.
english_explanation: Books are important sources of knowledge and entertainment.
akan_explanation: Nwoma yɛ adeɛ a wɔkyerɛw anaa wɔtintim mu nsɛm de kenkan na sua adeɛ.

meaning: Information and understanding gained through learning or experience.
description: Knowledge is what a person knows and understands about a subject.
english_explanation: Knowledge can be gained through education, experience, observation, and study.
akan_explanation: Nimdeɛ yɛ nea obi sua na ɔte ase fa biribi ho.

meaning: The ability to use knowledge and good judgment correctly.
description: Wisdom involves making sensible decisions based on knowledge and experience.
english_explanation: A wise person knows how and when to apply knowledge.
akan_explanation: Nyansa yɛ tumi a obi wɔ de hu nea ɛyɛ na ɔyɛ adeɛ wɔ berɛ a ɛsɛ mu.
example_english: Wisdom helps people make good decisions.
example_twi: Nyansa boa nnipa ma wɔyɛ gyinaeɛ pa.

meaning: The ability to understand the meaning of something.
description: Understanding means having a clear idea of a subject or situation.
english_explanation: Understanding develops when information is correctly interpreted.
akan_explanation: Nteeaseɛ kyerɛ sɛ obi ate biribi ase yiye.
example_twi: Nteeaseɛ ho hia wɔ adesua mu.

meaning: The process of gaining knowledge, skills, and understanding.
description: Education develops a person's intellectual and practical abilities.
english_explanation: Education can take place in schools, homes, communities, and other institutions.
akan_explanation: Nhomasua yɛ ɔkwan a obi fa so nya nimdeɛ, nyansa ne nimdeɛ a ɛboa no wɔ abrabɔ mu.
example_twi: Nhomasua ho hia ma ɔman no.

meaning: A period or activity in which something is taught or learned.
description: A lesson is an organized part of learning.
english_explanation: Lessons help students understand specific subjects or concepts.
akan_explanation: Adesua yɛ berɛ anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ biribi ma asuafoɔ sua.

meaning: Something asked to obtain information or an answer.
description: A question is used to seek knowledge, clarification, or information.
english_explanation: Questions are important in learning and communication.
akan_explanation: Asɛmmisa yɛ asɛm a obi bisa sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔnya mmuaeɛ anaa nkyerɛkyerɛmu.

meaning: A response given to a question.
description: An answer provides information or a solution to a question.
english_explanation: Answers can be spoken, written, calculated, or demonstrated.
akan_explanation: Mmuaeɛ yɛ nea obi ka anaa ɔkyerɛ de ma asɛmmisa bi ho mmuaeɛ.

meaning: A formal test used to assess knowledge or ability.
description: An examination measures what a learner knows or can do.
english_explanation: Examinations are commonly used in schools to assess students.
akan_explanation: Sɔhwɛ yɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hwɛ nimdeɛ ne nteaseɛ a osuani anya.
example_english: The students are preparing for the examination.
example_twi: Asuafoɔ no resiesie wɔn ho ama sɔhwɛ no.

meaning: To spend time learning or examining something.
description: Studying involves reading, practicing, observing, and thinking about a subject.
english_explanation: Students study to improve their knowledge and prepare for examinations.
akan_explanation: Sua adeɛ kyerɛ sɛ obi de n'adwene ne ne berɛ sua biribi yiye.

meaning: To look at and understand written words.
description: Reading is the process of interpreting written language.
english_explanation: Reading helps people gain information, knowledge, and enjoyment.
akan_explanation: Kenkan kyerɛ sɛ obi hwɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw na ɔte ase.

meaning: To form words or information using written symbols.
description: Writing is the process of recording ideas using letters and symbols.
english_explanation: Writing is used for communication, learning, records, and examination answers.
akan_explanation: Kyerɛw kyerɛ sɛ obi de nkyerɛwde yɛ nsɛm wɔ krataa anaa baabi foforɔ so.

meaning: To gain knowledge or skill through study or experience.
description: Learning happens when a person gains new understanding or ability.
english_explanation: People learn through teaching, reading, practice, observation, and experience.
akan_explanation: Sua kyerɛ sɛ obi nya nimdeɛ anaa nimdeɛ foforɔ wɔ biribi ho.
example_english: Children learn new things every day.
example_twi: Mmofra sua nneɛma foforɔ da biara.

meaning: A group of people related to one another.
description: A family may include parents, children, siblings, and other relatives.
english_explanation: Families provide care, support, identity, and belonging.
akan_explanation: Abusua yɛ nnipa a wɔnam mogya anaa abusua ntam ayɔnkofa so wɔ abusuabɔ.
example_english: My family is important to me.

meaning: A female parent.
description: A mother is a woman who gives birth to or cares for a child.
english_explanation: Mothers commonly provide care, guidance, and support to their children.
akan_explanation: Ɛna yɛ ɔbaa a ɔwoo ɔba anaa ɔhwɛ ɔba.

meaning: A male parent.
description: A father is a man who has a child or takes parental responsibility.
english_explanation: Fathers can provide care, guidance, protection, and support.
akan_explanation: Agya yɛ ɔbarima a ɔwoo ɔba anaa ɔhwɛ ɔba sɛ ne papa.

meaning: A young human being.
description: A child is a young person who is still developing physically and mentally.
english_explanation: Children require care, protection, education, and guidance.
akan_explanation: Ɔba yɛ onipa kumaa a ɔda so renyin.

meaning: A person with whom one has a close and trusting relationship.
description: A friend is someone who offers companionship, care, and support.
english_explanation: Friendship is built through trust, respect, kindness, and shared experiences.
akan_explanation: Adamfo yɛ obi a wo ne no wɔ ayɔnkofa pa ne ahotosoɔ.

meaning: A human being.
description: A person is an individual human being.
english_explanation: Every person has a unique identity, abilities, responsibilities, and rights.
akan_explanation: Onipa yɛ adamfo anaa ɔdesani a ɔte wiase sɛ nnipa no mu baako.

meaning: Human beings considered as a group.
description: People refers to more than one person.
english_explanation: People form families, communities, societies, and nations.
akan_explanation: Nnipa yɛ nnipa pii a wɔbom te wiase anaa wɔbom yɛ biribi.
example_twi: Nnipa hia wɔn ho wɔn ho.

meaning: The place where a person lives.
description: Home is a place where people live, rest, and belong.
english_explanation: A home may be a house or another place where someone lives.
akan_explanation: Fie yɛ beaeɛ a obi te na ɔnya ahomegyeɛ ne ahobammɔ.

meaning: A building used as a place for people to live.
description: A house is a physical structure that provides shelter.
english_explanation: Houses may contain rooms used for sleeping, cooking, resting, and other activities.
akan_explanation: Dan yɛ adan a nnipa te mu na ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban firi awia, nsuo ne awɔw ho.

meaning: Something eaten to provide nourishment.
description: Food provides energy and nutrients needed by the body.
english_explanation: People need food to grow, stay healthy, and have energy.
akan_explanation: Aduane yɛ nea nnipa di de nya ahoɔden ne ahoɔden a ɛboa nipadua.

meaning: To take food into the body through the mouth.
description: Eating is the act of consuming food.
english_explanation: Eating provides the body with energy and nutrients.
akan_explanation: Di kyerɛ sɛ obi de aduane hyɛ n'anom na ɔdi.

meaning: To take liquid into the body through the mouth.
description: Drinking is the act of consuming a liquid.
english_explanation: People drink water and other liquids to stay hydrated.
akan_explanation: Nom kyerɛ sɛ obi de nsuo anaa nsã bi hyɛ n'anom.

meaning: An activity performed to achieve a purpose or earn a living.
description: Work can involve physical or mental effort.
english_explanation: People work to provide services, create things, solve problems, or earn income.
akan_explanation: Adwuma yɛ biribi a obi yɛ de nya sika, boa afoforɔ anaa wie botaeɛ bi.
example_english: He goes to work every morning.

meaning: A medium used to buy goods and services.
description: Money is used in trade and economic activities.
english_explanation: Money allows people to pay for goods, services, and other needs.
akan_explanation: Sika yɛ adeɛ a wɔde tua nneɛma ne nnwuma ho ka na wɔyɛ aguadi.
example_english: Money is needed to buy goods.

meaning: A place or system where goods and services are bought and sold.
description: A market connects buyers and sellers.
english_explanation: Markets are important for trade and distribution of goods.
akan_explanation: Gua yɛ beaeɛ a wɔtɔn na wɔtɔ nneɛma.
example_english: My mother went to the market.

meaning: To obtain something by paying money for it.
description: Buying involves exchanging money or value for goods or services.
english_explanation: People buy things they need or want.
akan_explanation: Tɔ kyerɛ sɛ obi de sika anaa adeɛ bi ma na ɔnya adeɛ foforɔ.
example_english: I want to buy a book.

meaning: To give something to someone in exchange for money.
description: Selling is the opposite side of a purchase.
english_explanation: People sell goods or services to earn income.
akan_explanation: Tɔn kyerɛ sɛ obi de adeɛ ma obi foforɔ na ɔgye sika.
example_english: They sell food at the market.

meaning: Having desirable or positive qualities.
description: Good describes something that is useful, acceptable, kind, or of high quality.
english_explanation: The word good can describe people, actions, objects, or situations.
akan_explanation: Pa kyerɛ biribi a ɛyɛ fɛ, ɛyɛ yie, anaa ɛwɔ su pa.

meaning: Having undesirable or harmful qualities.
description: Bad describes something considered harmful, wrong, or unpleasant.
english_explanation: Bad can describe actions, conditions, behaviour, or objects.
akan_explanation: Bɔne kyerɛ biribi a ɛnsɛ, ɛyɛ bɔne anaa ɛwɔ su a ɛnyɛ.

meaning: Large in size, amount, or importance.
description: Big describes something that has considerable size or significance.
english_explanation: The word can describe physical size or importance.
akan_explanation: Kɛse kyerɛ biribi a ne kɛse anaa ne dodow yɛ pii.

meaning: Limited in size or amount.
description: Small describes something that is not large.
english_explanation: Small can refer to physical size, amount, or degree.
akan_explanation: Ketewa kyerɛ biribi a ne kɛse sua.
example_english: The child has a small bag.

meaning: Pleasant or attractive in appearance or quality.
description: Beautiful describes something that gives pleasure because of its appearance or qualities.
english_explanation: Beauty can relate to people, places, objects, or actions.
akan_explanation: Fɛ kyerɛ sɛ biribi yɛ anika na ɛyɛ ahomeka sɛ wohwɛ.

meaning: Feeling pleasure, joy, or satisfaction.
description: Happiness is a positive emotional state.
english_explanation: A person may feel happy because of good news, success, relationships, or enjoyable experiences.
akan_explanation: Ani agye kyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ anigyeɛ na ne koma ani gye.

meaning: Feeling unhappy or sorrowful.
description: Sadness is an unpleasant emotional state often caused by loss or disappointment.
english_explanation: People may feel sad when something painful or disappointing happens.
akan_explanation: Awerɛhow yɛ nkateɛ a obi nya bere a biribi ama ne werɛ aho anaa ɔredi awerɛhow.

meaning: A state of calm, harmony, and absence of conflict.
description: Peace exists when people or groups live without serious conflict.
english_explanation: Peace allows individuals and communities to live safely and cooperatively.
akan_explanation: Asomdwoeɛ yɛ tebea a ɔko, basabasayɛ ne ntawantawa nni mu.
example_english: We need peace in our community.
example_twi: Yɛhia asomdwoeɛ wɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ.

meaning: A state of armed conflict between groups or nations.
description: War involves organized fighting between opposing groups.
english_explanation: Wars can cause loss, destruction, displacement, and suffering.
akan_explanation: Ɔko yɛ ntawantawa a ɛyɛ den a ɛtumi de akodi ne basabasayɛ ba.

meaning: The state of being true or accurate.
description: Truth refers to what agrees with facts or reality.
english_explanation: Truth is important for trust, justice, communication, and relationships.
akan_explanation: Nokorɛ yɛ asɛm anaa adeɛ a ɛne nea ɛyɛ ankasa hyia.

meaning: A statement that is intentionally untrue.
description: A lie is information given with the intention of deceiving someone.
english_explanation: Lying can damage trust and relationships.
akan_explanation: Atoro yɛ asɛm a ɛnyɛ nokorɛ a obi ka sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdaadaa obi.

meaning: A feeling or expression of regard for someone or something.
description: Respect involves treating others with dignity and consideration.
english_explanation: Respect is important in families, schools, workplaces, and communities.
akan_explanation: Obu yɛ sɛ obi bu ne yɔnko, ɔde anidahɔ ne ahobrɛaseɛ di no.

meaning: The quality of being friendly, helpful, and caring.
description: Kindness involves doing good and showing concern for others.
english_explanation: Kindness strengthens relationships and communities.
akan_explanation: Ayamye yɛ suban a ɛma obi yɛ papa kyerɛ afoforɔ na ɔboa wɔn.

meaning: Assistance given to someone who needs it.
description: Help makes it easier for someone to complete a task or overcome difficulty.
english_explanation: People help one another in families, schools, workplaces, and communities.
akan_explanation: Mmoa yɛ biribi a obi yɛ de boa obi foforɔ wɔ ne haw anaa ne dwuma mu.
example_twi: Meda ase wɔ wo mmoa ho.

meaning: A difficult situation or question that needs a solution.
description: A problem is something that creates difficulty or requires an answer.
english_explanation: Problems can occur in mathematics, science, relationships, work, or daily life.
akan_explanation: Haw yɛ tebea anaa asɛm a ɛyɛ den na ɛhia sɛ wɔnya ano aduru.

meaning: An answer or method that solves a problem.
description: A solution removes or reduces a problem.
english_explanation: Solutions can be found through reasoning, experimentation, discussion, or calculation.
akan_explanation: Ano aduru yɛ ɔkwan anaa mmuaeɛ a wɔde siesie haw bi.
example_english: Find the solution to the problem.

meaning: Something that shows or explains what another thing is like.
description: An example makes an idea easier to understand.
english_explanation: Examples are commonly used by teachers to explain concepts.
akan_explanation: Nhwɛsoɔ yɛ biribi a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ anaa ma obi te adwene bi ase.

meaning: A cause or explanation for something.
description: A reason explains why something happens or why someone acts in a certain way.
english_explanation: Reasons are important in explanation, argument, and decision-making.
akan_explanation: Adwene wɔ ha kyerɛ nea enti a biribi sii anaa nea enti a obi yɛɛ biribi.
example_english: Give a reason for your answer.
example_twi: Ma wo mmuaeɛ no ho adwene.

meaning: Something that makes an event or condition happen.
description: A cause is the factor responsible for an effect.
english_explanation: Understanding causes helps explain why events happen.
akan_explanation: Adeɛ a ɛma biribi si yɛ nea ɛhyɛ anaa ɛma asɛm bi ba.
example_twi: Dɛn na ɛmaa akwanhyia no sii?

meaning: A result or consequence caused by something.
description: An effect is what happens because of a particular cause.
english_explanation: Effects help us understand the results of actions and events.
akan_explanation: Nsunsuansoɔ yɛ nea ɛba wɔ adeɛ bi akyi anaa ɛfiri adeɛ bi mu.
example_english: What are the effects of pollution?
example_twi: Dɛn ne nsunsuansoɔ a efiri efĩ mu ba?

meaning: Having great value, significance, or usefulness.
description: Something important deserves attention or consideration.
english_explanation: Importance refers to the value or significance of something.
akan_explanation: Hia kyerɛ sɛ biribi wɔ mfasoɔ paa anaa ɛho hia sɛ yɛhwɛ no yie.

meaning: The condition of being alive.
description: Life is the state in which living things exist and function.
english_explanation: Living things such as humans, animals, and plants have life.
akan_explanation: Nkwa yɛ tebea a adeɛ a ɛte ase wɔ mu.

meaning: The end of life.
description: Death is the state in which a living organism is no longer alive.
english_explanation: Death is a natural biological event.
akan_explanation: Owuo yɛ bere a nkwa ba awiei ma onipa anaa adeɛ a ɛte ase.
example_english: Death is part of human existence.
example_twi: Owuo yɛ nnipa asetena no fã.

meaning: The star that provides light and heat to Earth.
description: The sun is the main natural source of light and energy for Earth.
english_explanation: Plants use sunlight during photosynthesis.
akan_explanation: Owia yɛ nsoromma a ɛma yɛn wiase nya hann ne ɔhyew.

meaning: The natural satellite of Earth.
description: The moon is the celestial body that orbits Earth.
english_explanation: The moon is visible mainly at night and reflects sunlight.
akan_explanation: Ɔsram yɛ ɔsoro adeɛ a ɛdi Asase akyi na yɛtaa hu no anadwo.

meaning: A process of burning that produces heat and light.
description: Fire is produced when combustible material burns.
english_explanation: Fire can be useful for cooking and heating but can also be dangerous.
akan_explanation: Ogya yɛ adeɛ a ɛma ɔhyew ne hann ba bere a biribi redɛw.

meaning: The mixture of gases surrounding Earth.
description: Air is necessary for breathing and many natural processes.
english_explanation: Air contains gases such as oxygen and nitrogen.
akan_explanation: Mframa yɛ mframa a ɛwɔ yɛn atwa ho nyinaa mu na yɛhome mu.

meaning: The land or planet on which people and other living things exist.
description: Earth is the planet where humans live; asase can also mean land or soil.
english_explanation: Earth contains land, water, air, and living organisms.
akan_explanation: Asase yɛ yɛn wiase no ne fam a nnipa ne afifideɛ tumi tena so.
example_twi: Afoforo yɛ adwuma wɔ asase so.

meaning: A large plant with a woody stem or trunk.
description: Trees are plants that can provide food, shade, wood, and oxygen.
english_explanation: Trees are important parts of forests and ecosystems.
akan_explanation: Dua yɛ afifideɛ kɛseɛ a ne dua yɛ den na ɛwɔ nkorabata ne nhaban.

meaning: A living organism that generally grows in soil and produces its own food.
description: Plants are living organisms important to ecosystems and human life.
english_explanation: Plants provide food, oxygen, medicine, and materials.
akan_explanation: Afifideɛ yɛ nneɛma a ɛte ase a ɛnyɛ mmoa na ɛnyɛ nnipa.

meaning: A living organism that is not a plant or human.
description: Animals are living organisms that generally move and depend on other organisms for food.
english_explanation: Animals include mammals, birds, reptiles, fish, and insects.
akan_explanation: Aboa yɛ adeɛ a ɛte ase a ɛnyɛ afifideɛ na ɛnyɛ onipa.

meaning: A warm-blooded animal with feathers and wings.
description: Birds are animals characterized by feathers, beaks, and wings.
english_explanation: Most birds can fly, although some species cannot.
akan_explanation: Anoma yɛ aboa a ɔwɔ ntakra, ntaban ne ano na nnipa pii hu sɛ ɔtumi tu.

meaning: A domesticated animal commonly kept as a companion or for protection.
description: Dogs are domesticated mammals that can serve as companions and working animals.
english_explanation: Dogs are commonly kept for companionship, security, hunting, and assistance.
akan_explanation: Ɔpɔnkɔ yɛ aboa a nnipa tumi yɛ no afieboa de yɛ ahobammɔ anaa ayɔnkofa.

meaning: To move from one place to another.
description: Going involves movement away from the current location.
english_explanation: The verb go is commonly used to describe movement or travel.
akan_explanation: Kɔ kyerɛ sɛ obi fi baabi rekɔ baabi foforɔ.

meaning: To move toward a person or place.
description: Coming involves movement toward the speaker or a specified location.
english_explanation: The verb come describes movement toward a particular point.
akan_explanation: Ba kyerɛ sɛ obi fi baabi reba baabi a ɔkasafoɔ wɔ anaa wɔrekyerɛ.

meaning: To rest in a seated position.
description: Sitting involves placing the body in a seated position.
english_explanation: People sit for rest, work, eating, learning, and other activities.
akan_explanation: Tena kyerɛ sɛ obi tena ase wɔ akonnwa anaa fam.

meaning: To rise to or remain in an upright position.
description: Standing means supporting the body upright on the feet.
english_explanation: People stand for movement, work, greetings, and other activities.
akan_explanation: Sɔre kyerɛ sɛ obi fi ase tena anaa ɔda hɔ na ɔgyina ne nan so.

meaning: To move by stepping with the feet.
description: Walking is a common form of human movement.
english_explanation: Walking is used for transportation, exercise, and daily activities.
akan_explanation: Nante kyerɛ sɛ obi de ne nan tu anammɔn kɔ baabi.

meaning: To move quickly using the legs.
description: Running is faster movement in which both feet may leave the ground briefly.
english_explanation: Running is used for sport, exercise, travel, and emergencies.
akan_explanation: Tu mmirika kyerɛ sɛ obi de ahoɔden tu anammɔn ntɛm.
example_twi: Abarimaa no tumi tu mmirika ntɛm.

meaning: To rest in a state in which the body and mind become less active.
description: Sleep is an essential period of rest.
english_explanation: Adequate sleep helps the body and brain recover.
akan_explanation: Da kyerɛ sɛ obi kɔ ahomegyeɛ mu na ne nteaseɛ ne ne nipadua dwumadi yɛ brɛoo.

meaning: To stop sleeping and become awake.
description: Waking occurs when a sleeping person becomes conscious again.
english_explanation: People normally wake after sleeping.
akan_explanation: Sɔre wɔ ha kyerɛ sɛ obi fi nna mu ba ɛnnɛ.

meaning: To perceive something with the eyes.
description: Seeing is the ability to observe through vision.
english_explanation: Vision allows people to recognize objects, people, and surroundings.
akan_explanation: Hu kyerɛ sɛ obi de n'ani hwɛ adeɛ na ɔhunu.

meaning: To perceive sound through the ears.
description: Hearing is the ability to detect and understand sounds.
english_explanation: People use hearing to communicate and understand their surroundings.
akan_explanation: Te kyerɛ sɛ obi de n'aso tie na ɔte nnyegyeeɛ anaa asɛm.

meaning: To communicate using spoken words.
description: Speaking involves producing words to communicate ideas or information.
english_explanation: People speak to communicate with one another.
akan_explanation: Ka kyerɛ sɛ obi de n'ano kasa na ɔda ne nsusuiɛ anaa ne nkateɛ adi.

meaning: To pay attention to sounds or what someone says.
description: Listening involves actively paying attention to spoken information.
english_explanation: Good listening improves communication and understanding.
akan_explanation: Tie kyerɛ sɛ obi de n'aso ne n'adwene si asɛm a obi reka so.

meaning: To use the mind to consider or understand something.
description: Thinking involves mental processes such as reasoning, remembering, and planning.
english_explanation: Thinking helps people solve problems and make decisions.
akan_explanation: Dwene kyerɛ sɛ obi de n'adwene yɛ nhwehwɛmu fa biribi ho.

meaning: To have knowledge or understanding of something.
description: Knowing means having information or awareness about something.
english_explanation: Knowledge can come from learning, experience, observation, or teaching.
akan_explanation: Nim kyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ nimdeɛ fa biribi ho anaa ɔte biribi ase.

meaning: To grasp the meaning of something.
description: Understanding occurs when information becomes clear to the mind.
english_explanation: Understanding is essential for effective learning.
akan_explanation: Te ase kyerɛ sɛ obi ate biribi mu nteaseɛ na ɛda ne koma ne n'adwene mu.

meaning: To retain or recall information in the mind.
description: Remembering is the ability to bring stored information back to awareness.
english_explanation: Memory helps students recall facts, concepts, names, and experiences.
akan_explanation: Kae kyerɛ sɛ obi tumi san kae biribi a ɔasua anaa ɔahu dada.

meaning: To fail to remember something.
description: Forgetting occurs when information cannot be recalled.
english_explanation: People may forget information because of time, distraction, or lack of practice.
akan_explanation: Werɛ fi kyerɛ sɛ obi ntumi nkae biribi a ɔnim anaa ɔsuaa dada.

meaning: Strong belief or trust in someone or something.
description: Faith involves trusting or believing even when something is not directly seen.
english_explanation: Faith is commonly discussed in religious and spiritual contexts.
akan_explanation: Gyidi yɛ ahotosoɔ ne gyina pintinn wɔ obi anaa biribi mu.

meaning: The supreme divine being in Christian and many religious contexts.
description: Nyankopɔn is a common Akan name used for God.
english_explanation: In Christianity, God is understood as the creator and supreme being.
akan_explanation: Nyankopɔn yɛ edin a Akanfoɔ de frɛ Onyankopɔn, Ɔbɔadeɛ ne Ɔsorosoroni.

meaning: Communication with God through speaking, asking, thanking, or worship.
description: Prayer is a religious practice of communicating with God.
english_explanation: Prayer may include thanksgiving, requests, confession, and worship.
akan_explanation: Mpaebɔ yɛ ɔkwan a onipa fa so kasa kyerɛ Nyankopɔn, srɛ, da aseɛ anaa som no.

meaning: A Christian community or place where Christians worship.
description: A church may refer to a congregation, organization, or worship building.
english_explanation: Christians gather in churches for worship, teaching, prayer, and fellowship.
akan_explanation: Asɔre yɛ beaeɛ anaa Kristofoɔ kuw a wɔbom som Nyankopɔn.
example_english: We go to church on Sunday.

meaning: To communicate with God in prayer.
description: Praying is an act of speaking or communicating with God.
english_explanation: People pray to ask, thank, worship, or seek guidance from God.
akan_explanation: Bɔ mpaeɛ kyerɛ sɛ obi kasa kyerɛ Nyankopɔn de srɛ, da aseɛ anaa som no.

meaning: A feeling of expectation and desire for something good to happen.
description: Hope gives people confidence that a positive future is possible.
english_explanation: Hope can motivate people during difficult situations.
akan_explanation: Anidasoɔ yɛ ahotosoɔ sɛ adeɛ pa bi bɛba daakye.

meaning: The ability or power to perform an action or withstand difficulty.
description: Strength may be physical, mental, emotional, or spiritual.
english_explanation: Strength enables people to overcome challenges and perform tasks.
akan_explanation: Ahoɔden yɛ tumi a obi wɔ de yɛ adwuma anaa gyina ɔhaw ano.

meaning: The condition of being physically and mentally well.
description: Health involves the proper functioning and well-being of the body and mind.
english_explanation: Good health is supported by nutrition, exercise, rest, hygiene, and medical care.
akan_explanation: Apɔmuden yɛ tebea a nipadua ne adwene wɔ mu yie na ɛyɛ adwuma sɛnea ɛsɛ.

meaning: The physical structure of a living person or animal.
description: The body consists of organs, tissues, bones, muscles, and other structures.
english_explanation: The human body performs many functions necessary for life.
akan_explanation: Nipadua yɛ onipa honam ne ne nipadua afã nyinaa.

meaning: The organ used for seeing.
description: The eye detects light and allows vision.
english_explanation: Eyes enable people and animals to see their surroundings.
akan_explanation: Ani yɛ nipadua no fã a wɔde hu adeɛ.
example_twi: Ani boa yɛn ma yɛhu adeɛ.

meaning: The organ used for hearing.
description: The ear detects sounds and helps maintain balance.
english_explanation: Ears allow people to hear speech, music, and environmental sounds.
akan_explanation: Aso yɛ nipadua no fã a wɔde te nnyegyeeɛ.

meaning: The upper part of the human body containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.
description: The head contains important sensory and control organs.
english_explanation: The brain inside the head controls many body functions.
akan_explanation: Ti yɛ nipadua no atifi a ɛwɔ ani, aso, hwene ne ano.

meaning: A muscular organ that pumps blood through the body.
description: The heart is essential for circulating blood.
english_explanation: The heart pumps blood containing oxygen and nutrients around the body.
akan_explanation: Koma yɛ nipadua mu akwaa a ɛhyɛ mogya ma ɛkɔ nipadua no afã horow.
example_twi: Koma no hyɛ mogya ma ɛkɔ nipadua no mu.

meaning: The red fluid that circulates through the body.
description: Blood transports oxygen, nutrients, hormones, and waste products.
english_explanation: Blood is essential for maintaining the body's functions.
akan_explanation: Mogya yɛ nsuo kɔkɔɔ a ɛfa nipadua mu na ɛboa ma nipadua no yɛ adwuma.
example_english: Blood carries oxygen around the body.
example_twi: Mogya fa oxygen kɔ nipadua no afã horow.

meaning: The continuous progression in which events occur.
description: Time allows people to measure duration and sequence events.
english_explanation: Time is measured using units such as seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, and years.
akan_explanation: Berɛ yɛ ɔkwan a yɛfa so kyerɛ bere tenten anaa bere a adeɛ bi sii.

meaning: A period of twenty-four hours.
description: A day is a common unit of time.
english_explanation: A day includes daytime and nighttime.
akan_explanation: Da yɛ berɛ a ɛyɛ nnɔnhwereɛ aduonu anan.

meaning: The period of darkness between evening and morning.
description: Night is generally the darker part of a twenty-four-hour day.
english_explanation: People commonly sleep and rest during the night.
akan_explanation: Anadwo yɛ bere a owia nni soro na sum ahyɛ wiase no so.

meaning: The early part of the day.
description: Morning begins after night and before afternoon.
english_explanation: Morning is commonly associated with waking, beginning work, and starting daily activities.
akan_explanation: Anɔpa yɛ da no fã a ɛdi anadwo akyi na ɛyɛ bere a nnipa sɔre.

meaning: The present day.
description: Today refers to the day that is currently happening.
english_explanation: Today is used to distinguish the present day from yesterday and tomorrow.
akan_explanation: Ɛnnɛ kyerɛ da a yɛwɔ mu seesei.

meaning: The day after today.
description: Tomorrow refers to the next day.
english_explanation: Tomorrow is used when talking about future plans or events.
akan_explanation: Ɔkyena yɛ da a ɛbɛba wɔ ɛnnɛ akyi.

meaning: The day before today.
description: Yesterday refers to the previous day.
english_explanation: Yesterday is used to refer to recent past events.
akan_explanation: Nnora yɛ da a ɛbaa ansa na ɛnnɛ reba.

meaning: The time that is yet to come.
description: The future refers to events that have not happened yet.
english_explanation: People make plans and predictions about the future.
akan_explanation: Daakye yɛ bere a ɛda yɛn anim a nsɛm a ɛbɛsi da so nsi.
example_english: We should prepare for the future.
example_twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsiesie yɛn ho ma daakye.

meaning: The time that has already happened.
description: The past includes events and experiences that occurred before the present.
english_explanation: History is largely concerned with events from the past.
akan_explanation: Berɛ a atwam yɛ bere ne nsɛm a ɛsii dada na ɛnsi bio seesei.
example_english: We can learn from the past.
example_twi: Yebetumi asua biribi afi nea atwam no mu.

meaning: A group of people living in the same area or sharing common interests.
description: A community is formed by people who share a place, identity, or purpose.
english_explanation: Communities cooperate to solve problems and support their members.
akan_explanation: Mpɔtam yɛ beaeɛ a nnipa tena bom na wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nsɛm.

meaning: A country or organized political community.
description: A nation consists of people connected by territory, government, or shared identity.
english_explanation: Nations have governments, laws, territories, and populations.
akan_explanation: Ɔman yɛ nnipa ne asase a wɔwɔ aban ne mmara a ɛhwɛ wɔn so.

meaning: The system or group responsible for governing a country or community.
description: Government creates policies, administers laws, and provides public services.
english_explanation: Governments manage public affairs and national development.
akan_explanation: Aban yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnipa a wɔhwɛ ɔman no so na wɔhwɛ mmara ne ɔman no dwumadi so.
example_twi: Aban no ma ɔmanfoɔ nya ɔsom ahorow.

meaning: A rule established by an authority or government.
description: Laws regulate behaviour and relationships within society.
english_explanation: Laws help maintain order, protect rights, and guide citizens.
akan_explanation: Mmara yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ anaa mmara a aban anaa ɔmanfoɔ de si hɔ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔdi so.
example_twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɔmanfoɔ di mmara so.

meaning: The condition of being free to act or choose within lawful limits.
description: Freedom means having the ability to make choices without unjust control.
english_explanation: Freedom is an important principle in human rights and democratic societies.
akan_explanation: Ahofadi yɛ tebea a obi wɔ mu tumi yɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ a nhyɛsoɔ a ɛmfata nsi no so.
example_twi: Ahofadi ho hia wɔ ɔman mu.

meaning: A duty or obligation that a person is expected to fulfill.
description: Responsibility means being accountable for one's duties and actions.
english_explanation: Responsible people complete their duties and accept the consequences of their actions.
akan_explanation: Asɛdeɛ yɛ dwuma anaa asɛmfua a wɔde ahyɛ obi nsa sɛ ɔyɛ.

meaning: The achievement of a desired goal or result.
description: Success occurs when a person or group achieves an intended objective.
english_explanation: Success often requires planning, effort, discipline, and perseverance.
akan_explanation: Nkɔsoɔ kyerɛ sɛ obi anya nea ɔrepɛ anaa ne tebea akɔ anim.
example_english: Hard work can lead to success.

meaning: The lack of success in achieving a desired result.
description: Failure occurs when an intended objective is not achieved.
english_explanation: Failure can provide opportunities to learn, improve, and try again.
akan_explanation: Di nkoguo kyerɛ sɛ obi antumi anni botaeɛ bi ho nkonim.
example_english: Failure can teach us important lessons.
example_twi: Nkoguo tumi ma yɛsua adesua a ɛho hia.

meaning: An objective or result that a person wants to achieve.
description: A goal gives direction to actions and plans.
english_explanation: Students can set academic goals to guide their studies.
akan_explanation: Botaeɛ yɛ nea obi asi ne bo sɛ ɔbɛyɛ anaa ɔbɛnya.
example_twi: Si botaeɛ a ɛda hɔ pefee.

meaning: The ability to control behaviour and consistently follow rules or plans.
description: Discipline helps a person remain focused and responsible.
english_explanation: Students need discipline to manage study time and complete responsibilities.
akan_explanation: Ahosiesie wɔ ha kyerɛ sɛ obi tumi di ne ho so na ɔyɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ.
example_twi: Ahosiesie boa asuafoɔ ma wɔdi nkonim.

meaning: The ability to wait calmly or endure difficulty without becoming upset.
description: Patience involves remaining calm while waiting or facing challenges.
english_explanation: Patience is useful in learning, relationships, work, and difficult situations.
akan_explanation: Aboterɛ yɛ tumi a obi wɔ de twɛn anaa gyina ɔhaw ano a ne bo mfuw.

meaning: Strong and persistent effort toward a task or goal.
description: Hard work involves sustained effort, dedication, and perseverance.
english_explanation: Hard work is often necessary for achieving difficult goals.
akan_explanation: Adwumaden yɛ sɛ obi de ahoɔden ne ne berɛ nyinaa yɛ biribi sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔwie no yiye.

meaning: Lack of willingness to work or make an effort.
description: Laziness involves avoiding necessary effort or activity.
english_explanation: Laziness can prevent a person from reaching goals.
akan_explanation: Kwasea wɔ ha kyerɛ sɛ obi mpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma anaa ɔde mmɔdenbɔ yɛ biribi.

meaning: Good judgment developed through knowledge and experience.
description: Wisdom helps a person make sound decisions.
english_explanation: Wisdom involves knowing what is right and applying knowledge appropriately.
akan_explanation: Nyansa yɛ nimdeɛ ne nteaseɛ a obi de yɛ gyinaeɛ pa.

meaning: A choice made after considering different possibilities.
description: A decision determines what someone chooses to do.
english_explanation: Good decisions often require information, reasoning, and wisdom.
akan_explanation: Gyinaeɛ yɛ nea obi si so wɔ bere a ɔsusuw nneɛma ho awie.

meaning: The process of using logic and evidence to reach a conclusion.
description: Reasoning helps people analyze information and solve problems.
english_explanation: Reasoning is important in mathematics, science, examinations, and decision-making.
akan_explanation: Adwene mu nhwehwɛmu yɛ sɛ obi de n'adwene ne nsɛm a ɔwɔ hwehwɛ mu de nya mmuaeɛ.
example_twi: Adwene mu nhwehwɛmu ho hia wɔ akontabuo mu.

meaning: The systematic study of the natural world through observation and evidence.
description: Science uses observation, testing, evidence, and reasoning to understand nature.
english_explanation: Science includes subjects such as biology, chemistry, physics, and earth science.
akan_explanation: Nyansahu yɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde sua abɔdeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛsi wɔ wiase mu denam adanseɛ ne sɔhwɛ so.
example_twi: Nyansahu boa yɛn ma yɛte abɔdeɛ ase.

meaning: The use of scientific knowledge to create tools and solve practical problems.
description: Technology includes tools, machines, software, systems, and processes developed by humans.
english_explanation: Technology is used in communication, education, medicine, transportation, and industry.
akan_explanation: Mfiridwuma yɛ nimdeɛ ne akwan a nnipa de yɛ mfiri ne nneɛma a ɛboa ma adwuma yɛ mmerɛ.

meaning: An electronic device that processes, stores, and communicates information.
description: A computer performs operations on data according to instructions.
english_explanation: Computers are used in education, business, communication, research, and entertainment.
akan_explanation: Kɔmputa yɛ mfiri a ɛgye nsɛm, ɛyɛ ho adwuma na ɛkora nsɛm so.

meaning: A global network connecting computers and devices.
description: The internet enables communication, information sharing, and online services.
english_explanation: Students can use the internet to research topics and access educational resources.
akan_explanation: Intanɛt yɛ nkitahodie kɛseɛ a ɛka kɔmputa ne mfiri bom ma wɔtumi di nsɛm.
example_english: Students use the internet for research.

meaning: Facts or knowledge communicated about something.
description: Information consists of facts, details, or knowledge that can be communicated.
english_explanation: Information is essential for learning, decision-making, communication, and research.
akan_explanation: Nsɛm yɛ nkyerɛmu anaa nokwasɛm a ɛfa biribi ho a wɔde ma obi.

meaning: A system of words and rules used for communication.
description: Language allows people to communicate thoughts, feelings, knowledge, and culture.
english_explanation: Examples of languages include English, Twi, Ga, Ewe, French, and many others.
akan_explanation: Kasa yɛ nsɛmfua ne mmara a nnipa de di nkitaho.

meaning: A unit of language used to express meaning.
description: Words combine to form phrases and sentences.
english_explanation: Words are basic building blocks of spoken and written language.
akan_explanation: Asɛm yɛ kasa mu adeɛ a yɛde kyerɛ adwene anaa biribi ho nteaseɛ.
example_english: Learn a new word every day.

meaning: A group of words that expresses a complete thought.
description: A sentence usually contains a subject and a predicate or equivalent structure.
english_explanation: Sentences are used to communicate complete ideas in speech and writing.
akan_explanation: Kasamu yɛ nsɛm a wɔaboaboa ano ma ɛma adwene a edi mu da adi.

meaning: The idea or concept represented by a word, phrase, or action.
description: Meaning explains what something communicates or represents.
english_explanation: Understanding meaning is important in language learning and communication.
akan_explanation: Nkyerɛaseɛ yɛ nea asɛm, asɛmfua anaa adeɛ bi kyerɛ.
example_english: What is the meaning of this word?

meaning: A statement or description that makes something clear.
description: An explanation helps someone understand an idea, process, or reason.
english_explanation: Clear explanations are important in teaching and learning.
akan_explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so ma obi te biribi ase pefee.

meaning: Not the same as another person or thing.
description: Different indicates a difference between things.
english_explanation: The word is commonly used when comparing people, objects, ideas, or situations.
akan_explanation: Sono kyerɛ sɛ nneɛma mmienu anaa pii nyɛ pɛ.

meaning: Exactly alike or identical in a relevant way.
description: Same indicates that two or more things are alike or equal.
english_explanation: The word same is commonly used when comparing things.
akan_explanation: Pɛ kyerɛ sɛ nneɛma mmienu anaa pii te sɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho.

meaning: At an earlier time or prior to an event.
description: Before indicates that one event occurs earlier than another.
english_explanation: Before is used to describe sequence and time.
akan_explanation: Ansa kyerɛ bere a biribi nnya nsii na biribi foforɔ di kan sii.

meaning: At a later time or following an event.
description: After indicates that one event occurs later than another.
english_explanation: After is used to describe sequence and time.
akan_explanation: Akyi kyerɛ bere a biribi sii wɔ adeɛ foforɔ akyi.

meaning: For the reason that something happened or is true.
description: Because introduces a reason or cause.
english_explanation: Because is used to connect an action or event with its reason.
akan_explanation: Ɛfiri sɛ yɛde kyerɛ nea enti a biribi sii anaa ɛyɛ saa.
example_english: I study because I want to learn.
example_twi: Mesua adeɛ ɛfiri sɛ mepɛ sɛ mesua.

meaning: A word used to ask about a reason or cause.
description: Why asks for an explanation or reason.
english_explanation: Why questions are important for understanding causes and reasons.
akan_explanation: Adɛn yɛ asɛm a yɛde bisa nea enti a biribi sii.

meaning: A word used to ask about a thing, action, or information.
description: What is used to request identification or information.
english_explanation: What questions ask for information about things or actions.
akan_explanation: Dɛn yɛ asɛmmisa a yɛde bisa adeɛ anaa asɛm bi ho nsɛm.

meaning: A word used to ask about a person.
description: Who identifies a person or people.
english_explanation: Who is used when asking about someone's identity.
akan_explanation: Hwan yɛ asɛmmisa a yɛde bisa onipa a ɔyɛ biribi anaa ne ho.

meaning: A word used to ask about a place or location.
description: Where asks for information about position or location.
english_explanation: Where is used to locate a person, object, or event.
akan_explanation: He yɛ asɛmmisa a yɛde bisa beaeɛ a obi anaa adeɛ bi wɔ.

meaning: A word used to ask about manner, method, or condition.
description: How asks about the way something happens or is done.
english_explanation: How questions are useful for learning procedures and methods.
akan_explanation: Sɛn yɛ asɛmmisa a yɛde bisa sɛnea wɔyɛ biribi anaa tebea a biribi wɔ mu.

meaning: A major language and cultural group in West Africa, especially Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire.
description: Akan includes closely related varieties such as Twi and Fante.
english_explanation: Akan languages are widely spoken in Ghana and parts of Côte d'Ivoire.
akan_explanation: Akan yɛ kasa ne amammerɛ kuw kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Côte d'Ivoire, na Twi ka Akan kasa no ho.
example_english: Akan is widely spoken in Ghana.
example_twi: Wɔka Akan kasa wɔ Ghana mmeaeɛ pii.

meaning: A widely spoken Akan language variety in Ghana.
description: Twi is one of the major indigenous languages spoken in Ghana.
english_explanation: Twi is used in homes, communities, education, media, religion, and everyday communication.
akan_explanation: Twi yɛ Akan kasa a nnipa pii ka wɔ Ghana, titire wɔ Akanfoɔ mpɔtam ahorow.

meaning: The act of expressing gratitude or thanks.
description: Thanksgiving involves recognizing and appreciating benefits received.
english_explanation: Thanksgiving may be expressed toward people or toward God in religious settings.
akan_explanation: Aseda yɛ anisɔ a obi da no adi de kyerɛ sɛ w'ani asɔ nea wɔayɛ ama no.

meaning: The feeling of being thankful or appreciative.
description: Gratitude is appreciation for kindness, help, or blessings.
english_explanation: Gratitude can improve relationships and encourage positive behaviour.
akan_explanation: Anisɔ yɛ nkateɛ a obi nya bere a n'ani sɔ adeɛ a wɔayɛ ama no.
example_english: Show gratitude for what you have.
example_twi: Kyerɛ anisɔ wɔ nea wowɔ ho.

meaning: The state of being joined together for a common purpose.
description: Unity means people or groups cooperate rather than remain divided.
english_explanation: Unity can strengthen families, communities, organizations, and nations.
akan_explanation: Biakoyɛ yɛ sɛ nnipa bom yɛ adeɛ baako de yɛ botaeɛ koro.

meaning: Improvement of the social, economic, and physical conditions of a community.
description: Community development involves people working together to improve their environment and lives.
english_explanation: Development may include education, health, roads, sanitation, employment, and social services.
akan_explanation: Mpɔtam nkɔsoɔ yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne adwuma a wɔyɛ de ma mpɔtam no asetena kɔ anim.

meaning: The surroundings and conditions in which living things exist.
description: The environment includes air, water, land, plants, animals, and human surroundings.
english_explanation: A healthy environment supports human life and ecosystems.
akan_explanation: Atwa ho kyerɛ nneɛma a atwa onipa, aboa anaa afifideɛ ho ne tebea a wɔte mu.
example_twi: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbɔ yɛn atwa ho ban.

meaning: The introduction of harmful substances into the environment.
description: Pollution can affect air, water, soil, plants, animals, and human health.
english_explanation: Common forms include air pollution, water pollution, and land pollution.
akan_explanation: Efĩ yɛ nneɛma bɔne a wɔde gu mframa, nsuo anaa asase mu ma ɛsɛe atwa ho.
